items.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
B: May I take food into the museum?
W: No, you may not. ______________________
B: How about water?
W: Only bottled water is OK.
choices: You must not bring any food inside.
You don't have to bring water.
Please bring some food for me.
items.explain: No, you may not. 뒤에 금지 이유.

items.stem: A와 B의 대화가 어색한 것은?
choices:
A: May I eat here?
B: No, you may not eat inside the museum.

A: Mr. Lee, may I drink water in class?
B: Yes, you may.

A: I need a favor. Can you please fix my bike?
B: Sure. No problem.

A: For here or to go?
B: For here, please.

A: Excuse me. May I touch this golden bear?
B: Yes, you may. You must not touch anything in this room.
items.explain: 허락(Yes, you may.) 뒤에 금지가 이어져 모순.

items.stem: 주어진 우리말을 영작한 문장으로 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: 나는 잘 잊어버려서 항상 메모를 한다.
choices: I am forgetful, so I always write things down.
I am forgetful, so I always writing things down.
I am forgetting, so I always write things down.
I am forgetful, so I never write things down.
I am forgetful, because I always write things down.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어는?
items.box:
I ran ________ him, but I couldn't catch him.
My dog was running ________ a bike.
items.source: L5 본문 · 학습지 L5 Workbook B-3

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
items.box:
A: Is your bag heavier than mine?
B: No. ______________________________
choices: Mine is more heavy than yours.
Mine is the heavier than yours.

items.stem: 다음 단어에 대한 영어 뜻풀이로 적절하지 않은 것은?
choices: reduce: to make something smaller in amount or size
favor: something that you do to help someone
delivery: the act of eating a meal in a restaurant
items.explain: delivery: the act of bringing goods, letters, etc. to a particular person or place.

items.stem: 다음은 단어와 영어 뜻풀이를 작성한 것이다. 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
items.box:
catch: to take or hold something that is ________
feed: to give ________ to a person or an animal
sign: a ________ giving information, directions, a warning, etc.
throw: to send something through the ________ by using your arm and hand

items.stem: 다음 문장의 의미상 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?
items.box:
I went to the ________ and bought some bread.
Mr. Clark works as a(n) ________ at the museum. He cleans the building.
The news is talking about a terrible ________.
They are taking pictures of the crime ________.

items.stem: 글의 흐름상 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

box.title: My Three Wishes
lines: These are my three wishes. First, I want ⓐ[stay/to stay] healthy. I decided to exercise every morning. Second, I want to learn Spanish. I plan ⓑ[travel/to travel] around Spain this summer. Last, I want to take a piano lesson. I hope ⓒ[become/to become] a pianist in the future.

items.stem: 우리말 해석에 맞는 문장을 영작할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices:
There ________ a book on the table.
탁자 위에 책이 한 권 있다.

There ________ a bank near here.
이 근처에 은행이 있다.

There ________ not a cloud in the sky today.
오늘 하늘에 구름 한 점 없다.

There ________ many animals in the forest.
숲에는 많은 동물들이 있다.

There ________ water in the glass.
유리잔에 물이 있다.

items.stem: 문장에서 밑줄 친 단어의 의미가 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: We went to the park <u>right after</u> lunch. (바로 후에)
I helped my friend, and <u>in return</u>, he helped me. (대가로)
<u>Single-use</u> plastic bags are bad for the environment. (재사용할 수 있는)
I often <u>reuse</u> plastic bottles to water my plants. (재사용하다)
He took off the <u>label</u> from the bottle. (상표)

items.box:
M: Everybody, look over here, please. This is Sunflowers by Van Gogh.
G: Wow, this is my favorite painting. (A) ______________________
M: Yes, you may, but you must not use the flash.
G: Why not? It's a little dark in here.
M: I'm sorry, but using the flash can damage paintings.
G: Oh, I didn't know that.
M: Everyone, we'll move on to Monet's paintings next.
G: Great!

items.stem: 위 대화의 흐름상 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: May I take a picture of it?
Can you please turn on the light?
Do I have to use the flash?
items.explain: Yes, you may, but you must not use the flash. 에 어울리는 허락 요청.

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: The girl may use the flash.
It is bright in the room.
Using the flash can damage paintings.
They will look at Van Gogh's paintings next.
items.explain: 플래시는 그림을 훼손할 수 있다고 했다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices: I think <u>that</u> this garden is very beautiful.
I heard <u>that</u> plastic never goes away completely.
I guess <u>that</u> the answer is correct.
items.source: L5·L6 본문 · 학습지 L6 Warm-Up B

lines: Every day, we ⓐ<u>produce</u> lots of waste, and the Earth (가)<u>is getting sicker and sicker</u>. Do you want to save the Earth? Then, join the zero-waste challenge, and share your stories.

Olivia: My birthday was last Saturday, and my family and I (나)<u>ate out</u>. (A) (다)<u>There was lots of ⓑleftovers</u>, but we brought them home. The next day, I made a nice lunch out of them. (B) FYI, you can find great cooking ideas for leftovers on the Internet.

Domingo: My dog ⓒ<u>tore</u> my bag. (C) I learned that ⓓ<u>wasting</u> is important for zero-waste living. So, (라)<u>I decided fixing it and reuse it</u>. (D) I'm not very good at sewing, and (마)<u>I don't think that the bag looks perfect</u>. I guess it's all right.

Minsu: Yesterday, I took some plastic and glass bottles to a recycling machine near my house. (E) (바)<u>I put them into the machine one by one</u>, and I got some points ⓔ<u>in return</u>. What can I do with those points? Well, I can use them like money. Don't you think that's cool?

items.stem: 윗글의 (A)~(E) 중 문맥상 주어진 문장이 들어갈 곳으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: I wanted to buy a new one, but I thought again.
items.explain: 가방이 찢어진 뒤, 다시 생각해 고치기로 하는 흐름 (C).

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
윗글을 읽고 대답을 찾을 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What did Olivia make out of the leftovers?
Where did Minsu take the bottles?
How many points did Minsu get?

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (가)~(바) 중 문맥상, 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
items.explain: (다) There was → There were (leftovers 복수), (라) decided fixing → decided to fix.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
다음 중 밑줄 친 that을 생략할 수 없는 것은?
choices: We believe <u>that</u> she will win a prize.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 말에 담긴 의도로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
G: Dad, can you please fix my bag?
M: Now? I'm cooking dinner.
G: Oh, I see. Then, when can you fix it?
M: <u>I'll do it right after dinner.</u>
items.explain: 저녁 식사 후에 바로 해 주겠다는 약속.

lines: Last Saturday, someone threw a cake at the Monalisa in the Botero Museum in Bogota, Colombia. There were four eyewitnesses. What did they say? Read the following, and find the (B) ________.

I was looking at the Monalisa, and someone threw a cake at the painting. I turned around and saw an old man. He was standing in front of a wheelchair. I'm about 170 cm tall, and (A)<u>그는 나보다 조금 더 컸어요.</u>

An old man with gray hair was running away, and something fell off his head. It was his wig. I ran after him, but I couldn't ⓐ<u>catch</u> him. He was faster than me. In fact, the old man was not old. He was a young man with long brown hair.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)를 어법상 옳은 영어 문장으로 작성한 것은?
choices: he was little taller than me
he was a little taller than me
he was a little tall than me
he was more taller than me
he was the tallest than me

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 영어 뜻풀이로 알맞은 것은?
choices: to take or hold something that is moving
to give food to a person or an animal
to put your hand, finger, etc. on someone or something
to send something through the air by using your arm and hand

items.stem: 윗글의 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 목격자 진술을 읽고 범인을 찾으라는 말.

items.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
That movie is the best of the year.
They arrived the most earliest of all.
Math is more difficult than English.
The blue box is the biggest of the three.
Are there old computers on the desk?
There aren't much cheese on the pizza.
Helen is the best dancer in my school.
items.explain: 틀린 것: the most earliest → the earliest, There aren't much cheese → There isn't much cheese.

items.stem: 글을 읽고 질문에 대한 답을 글에서 찾아 8단어로 이루어진 하나의 영어 문장으로 작성하시오.

lines: I went to the crime scene, and there were pieces of cake all over the painting. There was also a wheelchair near the painting, and I found a cake box next to the wheelchair. The box was from Camila's Bakery.
질문: Diego, what did you find next to the wheelchair?

items.answer: I found a cake box next to the wheelchair.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 친 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 조건에 맞는 영어 문장을 작성하시오.
items.box:
G: Excuse me. <u>이 황금곰을 만져 봐도 될까요?</u>
M: No, you may not. You must not touch anything in this room.
G: OK, I understand.
items.answer: May I touch this golden bear?

items.stem: 주어진 모든 단어를 한 번씩만 사용하여 알맞은 순서로 배열하고 우리말 뜻과 일치하는 문장을 작성하시오.
items.box:
Camila는 케이크를 한 개만 팔아서 그를 똑똑히 기억한다.
( remembers / Camila / so / only one cake / clearly / sold / she / him )
items.answer: Camila sold only one cake, so she remembers him clearly.
